description: This is a shell script that sets up an interoperability testing framework, including functions to build specific git versions, generate wrapper scripts for git commands, and source external configuration files. It manages build directories, calls make, and handles version control operations.

methods.name: build_version
methods.description: Function to compute and possibly build a specific git version based on a revision identifier or current directory.

methods.name: wrap_git
methods.description: Function to emulate older git versions by creating a wrapper script.

methods.name: generate_wrappers
methods.description: Function to create git command wrappers for testing.
